release.releaseNotes:
Private update for Bob (Build 107).
Fix: Eliminated chat message leak where AI canned chat triggered in multiplayer with player name.
Fix: Deleted bots removed immediately & permanently on guest screens without cloud resurrection.
Bots toggle preserves across matches in same lobby, resets to OFF for new lobby.
Bot Speed selector in lobby: switch between L (1s), M (1.5s), and H (2s).
All existing gameplay, networking, live status strip layout, and theme fixes preserved.
